description: Business accounts in Judaeo-Arabic. Dating: 11th or 12th century. Listing many names and numbers. Mentions: Ibn al-Qābila; Abū Saʿd; Rosh ha-Qahal; al-Muʿallim; Ibn Qaṭāṭa(?); Abū Isḥāq Ibn Ṭībān; Abū ʿImrān Ibn Shimlāṣ; Shuwayʿ; Abū l-Khayr al-Ramlī(?). The scribe consistently omits the vav of Abū, e.g., writing אבעמראן instead of אבו עמראן.
description_he: חשבונות, כנראה. ביהודית-ערבית. כולל רשימה של שמות רבים ומספרים.
